summary_en: Life Corporation launched a tender offer for all ordinary shares of Albis Co., Ltd. (TSE Prime, code 7475) at 3,780 yen per share, with a minimum acceptance target of 4,171,200 shares (representing 66.62% ownership post-acquisition). The offer runs for 40 business days from September 9 to November 10, 2026, with the aim of taking Albis private. Mitsubishi Corporation, the largest shareholder holding 16.62%, has committed not to tender its shares.
title_en: Notice Regarding the Commencement of a Tender Offer for Albis Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 7475)
translation_en_brief:
Life Corporation, a Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime-listed company, announced on September 8, 2026, that its board of directors has resolved to acquire all ordinary shares of Albis Co., Ltd. (TSE Prime, code 7475) through a public tender offer for the purpose of taking the company private. Life Corporation will conduct the tender offer at a price of 3,780 yen per share from September 9 to November 10, 2026, covering 40 business days.

The minimum number of shares targeted for acquisition is 4,171,200 shares, which would result in Life Corporation holding 66.62 percent of Albis (or 66.74 percent when including restricted stock units held by directors and executive officers that cannot participate in the tender offer). Life Corporation currently owns 100 shares, representing 0.00 percent of Albis. Mitsubishi Corporation, Albis's largest shareholder holding 1,388,440 shares (16.62 percent ownership), has entered into a non-tendering agreement and committed not to tender its shares in the offer.

The board of Albis has expressed support for the tender offer and recommended that shareholders tender their shares. Upon successful completion of the tender offer, Life Corporation intends to proceed with squeeze-out procedures and delisting procedures to make Albis a wholly owned subsidiary, with the exception of Mitsubishi Corporation, which will remain as a shareholder.
